purpose: Versioned documentation of methodology-critical heuristics used by historical evidence and the planned replacement protocol. No current final inferential evidence is claimed.

task_strata.description: Scenario-name and category based task-family classification used for cohort quality, expected helper fit, and gap reports.
task_strata.status: protocol-defined heuristic, not independent benchmark label

helper_fit_taxonomy.no_current_helper_fit_definition: A task is marked no-current-helper-fit when no expected helper from the taxonomy intersects with retained tools loaded for the scenario; if no helpers are loaded, it falls back to whether the taxonomy expects any helper at all.
helper_fit_taxonomy.interpretation: No-current-helper-fit can indicate no expected helper, helper hidden, or helper absent from the current registry; it is a coverage proxy, not proof that no useful tool could exist.

routing.final_run_evidence_policy: Final frozen runs must set routing evidence to disabled or pinned; mtime-selected latest helper-contribution evidence is diagnostic/discovery behavior only.

cohort_quality.principle: Block low-diversity, near-duplicate-dominated, or contaminated cohorts unless an explicit diagnostic override is used.

protocol_gate_vs_final_claim.old_protocol_gate: Absolute +0.08 outcome/canonical-style gate used in earlier campaign automation.
protocol_gate_vs_final_claim.final_claim_criteria: Outcome/task-completion is the sole performance endpoint; relative task-completion lift and paired comparisons are reported, canonical/reference similarity is descriptive route-compatibility output only, and safety must remain clean.

generated_tool_adoption.interpretation: Accepted-but-uncalled, visible-not-called, or force-call-only tools are blocker diagnoses. They must not be collapsed into no-value conclusions without routing, schema, affordance, callability, safety, and value evidence.

bridge_policy.implementation: not active in the current SAGE evidence boundary
bridge_policy.scope: Synthetic bridge completions and route-around behavior are excluded from current SAGE evidence. Actor-facing guidance may explain visible generated-tool schemas and outputs, but it must not complete tasks from code-based benchmark knowledge.
bridge_policy.integrity_boundary: Current SAGE claims must be attributed to generated tools, validation/repair, registry retention, visible-context routing, natural generated-tool use, lifecycle feedback, and contribution accounting.

cache_policy.openai_response_cache: Legacy name for repository-level replay of complete model responses. It is disabled in strict publication runs and is distinct from OpenAI-managed prompt-prefix computation.
cache_policy.task_level_control_cache: Legacy and nonpublication runs may reuse eligible task-level baseline records with >=3 compatible completed controls. Strict publication runs prohibit construction or lookup and execute every control task live.
cache_policy.generator_contract_and_repair_analysis_m: Validated nonpersistent reuse is retained only within one generator lifetime and never loads data from another run.
cache_policy.openai_provider_prompt_prefix_cache: Automatic provider-side computation reuse is distinct from response replay. Strict runs require its usage metadata for every model call and reconcile raw events with task and arm totals.
